$comment: Your personal workspace layer. Deep-merged over workspace.json, and it wins. Versioned on an orphan branch pushed only to your fork — never to the shared repo's main. Put anything here whose value differs between developers.

parametric-enclosures.description: Repos carrying the parametric-enclosure patch set, in release order (dependencies first, docs last). Downstream rebuild-only repos (eval, runframe) are excluded - they carry no patch branch. jscad-electronics was dropped: its right-angle pin fix (tscircuit/jscad-electronics#318) is independent of this effort and not required by it. Override the effort with SYNC_FORK_EFFORT, or one branch for every repo with SYNC_FORK_BRANCH.

merge-fdm-enclosure.description: Focused migration after Props 0.0.619 and create-fdm-enclosure 0.0.4 published. Core consumes the new solver while retaining the existing synthetic cad_component Circuit JSON representation; 3d-viewer adds appearance controls for that single compatibility entity. Typed Circuit JSON, per-part renderer and CLI migrations are deliberately excluded.
